messages.subject: MSstats.daily 2.1.6 feedback
parts:
Hi!

I've tried MSstats.daily 2.1.6 on some test data (label-free DDA) and am happy to say that it works for me now. Thanks for fixing the problems that I reported before!

If I may express some - hopefully constructive - criticism, here are some aspects that I think could still be improved:
1. I've noticed that log files ("msstats.log") are now produced in the working directory - where I don't want them. How can I change this?
2. In the "transformMSnSetToMSstats" function: "data" should be the first (not the last) parameter, because it is the primary input and doesn't have a default value.
3. In "groupComparisonPlots(..., "VolcanoPlot", FCcutoff=x): An option to print protein names only for proteins that pass the FDR and fold-change cut-offs (those shown in blue/red) would be useful.
4. "groupComparisonPlots"/"dataProcessPlots": You should split these into individual functions for the different plots (if there is common code between them, move it into helper functions). Currently these functions contain parameters that are mutually exclusive and only work for some of the plots, which makes things confusing. On the implementation side, you currently have one function that is unnecessarily long and complex (and thus hard to maintain/improve).


Cheers

Hendrik
